import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from flax import linen as nn

# Define model with pluggable initializers
class VanillaCNNModel(nn.Module):
    kernel_init_strategy: callable = nn.initializers.lecun_normal()
    bias_init_strategy: callable = nn.initializers.zeros

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Pass the init strategy to layers
        x = nn.Conv(32, (3, 3), kernel_init=self.kernel_init_strategy, bias_init=self.bias_init_strategy)(x)
        # ...

# Mapping PyTorch inits to JAX/Flax
init_map = {
    "kaiming": nn.initializers.he_normal(), # He = Kaiming
    "xavier": nn.initializers.xavier_normal(),
    "zeros": nn.initializers.zeros,
    "random": nn.initializers.normal(stddev=0.01)
}

# Loop over configurations
for name, init_fn in init_map.items():
    # Re-initialize model with specific strategy
    model = VanillaCNNModel(kernel_init_strategy=init_fn)
    variables = model.init(jax.random.PRNGKey(0), dummy_input)
    # ... (Train loop)
